params.prompt: Graphic novel inked illustration, painted tableau, a frozen moment. Christ hangs crucified on a wooden cross against a darkened storm sky, wearing a simple robe, head bowed low, both arms outstretched with a single thin flat iron nail through each wrist, blood only at the small nail wound itself, dry and fixed, not spreading, not dripping further. The camera holds nearly still, an almost imperceptible settle, resting on the scene. Nothing moves -- every figure and element stays fixed as drawn, no blood grows, no blood drips, no blood spreads beyond what is painted at the wound. No invented motion, no morphing, no new elements, no camera shake. Painted tableau stays still; only the camera moves.
